title: Leakage-free counterfactual repair
status_justification: The rewritten generator passes all leakage tests (reads only model-visible sequence + demographics + real ontology + scorer feedback; never label/anomaly_type/hidden/audit/bad_code/expected_code/replacement_code). Evaluation ran on benchmark-v2 test (1000 anomalies). Among the 686 anomalies the real ontology actually flags, repair success (valid) is 90.5%; mean ΔS_ont 0.644; edits are sparse (median 1, mean 1.23). All four success criteria met.

old_code_audit.detail: old src/explanations/counterfactual.py read injection answer keys (bad_code/expected_code/replacement_code/anomaly_type) to undo the synthetic anomaly; never used the real ontology engine/scorer/distance. See artifacts/phase4/counterfactual_audit_before.md.
legacy_removed: scripts/evaluate_day36_counterfactuals.py (legacy leaky eval, read answer keys)

api.entry: generate_counterfactual(record, scorer, ontology_index, *, detector=None, max_edits=3, beam_size=20, mode='ontology', seed=42, min_delta=0.05)
api.result_type: CounterfactualResult (status, validity, original/repaired codes, edits, s_ont/s_cal/s_det before/after, rule_violations_before/after, sparsity, failure_reason, metadata)
api.edit_type: CounterfactualEdit (operation remove|replace|add, token_before, token_after, ontology_source, distance, clinical_risk, rationale)
api.determinism: deterministic (no randomness; seed accepted for reproducibility)

repair_strategies.demographic_mismatch: remove the sex-incompatible diagnosis token (primary); ontology-neighbor replace candidates generated but rarely selected (neighbors stay sex-restricted).
repair_strategies.missing_required_code: remove the unsupported medication (preferred, lower clinical risk) OR add a curated required-context diagnosis from the rule's allowed group (higher risk; used when removal does not resolve).
repair_strategies.mutual_exclusion: remove (or generalize) ONE side of the conflicting pair, chosen by score reduction + ontology distance -- never by knowing which side was injected.

repair_objective: minimize residual S_ont, then prefer fewer edits, smaller ontology distance, lower clinical risk: cost = S_ont + 0.05*n_edits + 0.02*distance + 0.10*risk (beam search, beam_size 20).
validity_definition: reduces S_ont by >= min_delta (0.05) OR resolves all violations,
introduces no NEW violation of higher severity than the worst original,
generated without any hidden metadata (structural guarantee).

evaluation.unflagged_note: S_ont_before==0 -> not flagged by the ontology (Phase 3b coverage gap, mostly uncovered medication anomalies). These are DETECTION gaps, not Phase 4 repair failures.
evaluation.detector: smoke-scale unsupervised GRU; ΔS_det reported as DIAGNOSTIC-only (mean 0.047), NOT a repair-success signal.

failures_remaining: Demographic gender-flips with MANY obstetric codes exceed the 3-edit budget (no_score_reducing_edit_found: 63) -- the clinically minimal repair (correct the sex) is outside the token-edit vocabulary specified for this phase.
Records the ontology does not flag (314/1000) cannot be repaired -- these are Phase 3b medication coverage gaps, not Phase 4 failures.
2 records reduce to empty after removing the only (conflicting) token -> rejected as invalid.
Validity = ontology-violation resolution, NOT clinician-verified clinical correctness (clinician review is C11/Phase 7).

leakage_protections.structural: generate_counterfactual reads only model-visible fields via extract_model_visible.
leakage_protections.behavioral_tests: tests/test_phase4_counterfactual_leakage.py: adding every answer key leaves the repair byte-identical; misleading answer keys are ignored; works with zero hidden metadata; outputs contain no hidden fields; static dict-access guard.

sanitized_examples.edit: remove MED_INSULIN (or add SNOMED:73211009 diabetes context)

claim_impact.C10_ontology_counterfactual_repair: cut_unless_fixed -> supported_now (scoped): leakage-free, ontology-grounded, minimal-edit repair validated by an independent scorer on the non-circular benchmark.
claim_impact.C9_diffusion_counterfactual: remains unsupported: the counterfactual is ONTOLOGY/edit-based, not diffusion-based (diffusion is a Phase 5 decision).

anti_cheating_compliance: no injection reversal via audit logs
anomaly_type NOT used as a rule selector
no silent legacy fallback (leaky code deleted)
no clinical-validity claim beyond rule-based plausibility
next_step: Phase 5 (generative/diffusion gate) is DONE = remove_from_core: on benchmark-v2 Sgen ROC-AUC 0.4868 (below chance) and harms the combined score; w_gen stays 0. Next is Phase 6 (full-scale training + experiment infrastructure) WITHOUT Sgen in the core. Full-scale detector training is part of Phase 6. Do NOT start H200 or large final training until Phase 6 requires it. See artifacts/phase5/.
